scope: Disposable central SQLite storage and authenticated in-process API; finite default capacity boundary.
fixture_population: One authenticated API commit plus 9,999 direct synthetic inserts; not 10,000 API ingests or sustained load.
limitations: Not ingestion throughput, latency, sustained load, remote transport, disk exhaustion, PostgreSQL capacity or physical acceptance evidence.
sanitization: Aggregate counts/statuses/assertions only; no identities, credentials, sessions, receipts, record IDs, database files or local paths.
